svg.title: HL Pirzath keyboard: Pirzath Carved, Pirzath Hand, Pirzath Hand Lifted
svg.text: Types Pirzath Carved, Pirzath Hand, Pirzath Hand Lifted by sound, on an ANSI (US) keyboard. Each key shows what it types plain, with Shift, with Option (AltGr) and with both.
Bottom left: the key. Top left: Shift + the key.
Bottom right: Option + the key (AltGr on Windows and Linux). Top right: Option + Shift + the key.
Grey characters type themselves. A small grey word under a glyph is the sound the key stands for.
